description.value:
A fantastical ability that allows you to cross vast distances in an instance. As a Bonus Action or Action on your turn, you may spend 1 Stamina to teleport to a location that you can see.

Whenever you successfully locate a target using Sense Ki, you may spend Stamina to teleport to them, as your Reaction to locating them or as your Action or Bonus Action so long as you can you continue to Sense Ki. You must spend 2 Stamina if they are on the same Planet, 3 Stamina if they are in the same Solar System, 4 Stamina if they are in the same Universe, or 5 Stamina if they are in the Other World/Divine Realm of your own Universe.
